committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 15 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test has used 32 raw clicks and A$193.60 ex GST of the A$600 credit, leaving A$352.21 remaining; with conversionsLast7 at 0, cost per qualified enquiry still can't be worked out until Chris grades the test log.
Impression share sits at 10%, with 73% of impressions lost to rank against only 21.6% lost to budget, so rank is the binding constraint, not budget (no change proposed while the test is running).

ask_cta_click has fired 7 times since the test started and /free-workflow-review.html has drawn 23 sessions, but totalPaidClicks has reached 32, so the page is past the 25-click freeze point and the copy and CTAs are locked unless something breaks.
Organic Search sessions fell from 18 to 14 and AI Assistant visits dropped to 0 from 4 last period with no top source recorded, so the one trustworthy unpaid signal is softening this week.

actions.text: Note that landingPageTest.totalPaidClicks has passed 25 (now 32); the page stays frozen, no further headline, offer or CTA edits unless something is broken.
Chase the outstanding logo and image assets for the Agency and Job Intake ad groups.
Update the RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads, they still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; refresh to the current site stats.
